integrity: The source code derives all transitions from domination and private-neighbor conditions; SHA-256 transition digest, five-step state-vector equalities, base cases, and independent direct face enumeration are checked.
scientific_limitations: A deterministic 206-state transfer system and finite exact max-plus certificate prove a static VC dimension, not the connected-path Littlestone dimension. The formula is a computer-assisted finite-state proof. Independent validation and exhaustive historical-priority certification are not claimed.
title: A sharp two-fifths VC law for inclusion-minimal domination on paths
